title: Senior Account Manager
description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

 

👐 About the team

Our Account Manager team key role is to position Alma as a true business partner with our top merchants. In short, our Account Managers are in charge of a portfolio of large accounts, with whom you'll work closely to make them successful.

You'll be arriving at the beginning of the experience, as our team was created in March 2021. There is still a lot to create! This means you'll have a key role in shaping the function.

Reporting to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will work closely with the Sales team, the Onboarding team, the Retail Training team and the Merchant Support team.

This position is a permanent role, based in Paris. 

 

💼 About the job

In a nutshell, your key responsibilities will consist in:

  • Manage, negotiate and retain a portfolio of large accounts. Establish trustful relationships with Alma’s large merchants. Be the key point of communication for the merchants' stakeholders, while working closely with the other functions (Onboarding, Training, Support).
  • Deliver meaningful insights. Analyse merchants' performance to provide superior insights on their businesses. Develop expertise in your field to constantly position Alma as a strategic partner, helping the merchants achieve their goals.
  • Identify key business opportunities. Identify up-sell/cross-sell opportunities on your accounts and develop strategic plans with the merchants. Ensure your accounts get the most out of Alma (maximise conversion, increase turnover, increase basket size) by leveraging the tools we have developed.
  • Be the voice of merchants. Share insights and feedback from merchants with the Product & Engineering team and the wider organisation, helping to constantly improve our solution and the merchants' experience.

 

🧰 You will work with

  • Salesforce
  • Gong
  • Aircall
  • Dust
  • SalesNavigator

 

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have ideally more than 5 years of relevant experiences (full-time permanent positions) in similar functions such as a Sales or an Account Manager / Shop manager in the Retail industry.
  • We are seeking individuals who demonstrate coachability and a strong willingness to learn and grow.
  • You’re fluent in French and a full professional proficiency in English are mandatory. 
  • Commercial skills: You like finding new opportunities for mutual gains. You are at ease in negotiation & closing discussions.
  • KPI Driven: You are comfortable and autonomous in managing your portfolio using identified key KPIs, you like talking numbers!

And it will be nice if you also

  • Demanding and reliable: You set high goals for yourself. You don't compromise on the quality of your work, and you always deliver on your commitments.
  • Empathetic: You easily get into other people's shoes. You are always keen to do the extra mile for clients to make them successful.
  • Autonomous and driven: You know how to find the solution to an issue and look for the information you need. You are comfortable obtaining information from the Alma teams who can help you obtain solutions quickly (product, finance, risk, sales etc...)
  • Great communicator: You have excellent written and oral communication skills. You know how to adapt to your audience.

 

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

 

🧘 What's in it for you?

  • Join a growing company that's reshaping how merchants and consumers connect
  • High ownership from day one, with real impact on business growth
  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and results matter
  • The chance to help build a category and be part of something meaningful

 

🤑 Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year ****(+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer


🎯 Interview Process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)
  • Remote Hiring Manager interview (45 min)
  • On-site/Remote Business Case Study presentation (60 min)
  • On-site Final interview with the VP Sales (45 min) + Team Fit (45 min)
  • Reference check

title: Responsable du restaurant ("Club Manager") - Soho House Paris H/F
description:
En tant que Club manager, vous êtes un ambassadeur de la marque et possédez une connaissance approfondie du groupe Soho House et de son concept, y compris l’ensemble des menus et de l’offre de restauration. Faisant preuve d’un professionnalisme irréprochable envers nos managers, nos collaborateurs et nos clients, vous êtes chargé(e) de la gestion quotidienne du Club, de l’organisation des événements qui y sont associés, ainsi que de l’expérience des membres et de leurs invités. Vous veiller au quotidien à ce que l’ensemble de l’équipe du Club fasse preuve d’une attitude positive, en accord avec les valeurs de Soho House Paris.

 Missions principales et responsabilités

  • Superviser les activités afférentes à la Restauration précisément du Club, du Bar et du Cabaret
  • Recruter, encadrer, développer et former le personnel de la Restauration
  • Être un leader inspirant pour l’équipe, la House et savoir résoudre les éventuelles difficultés rencontrées
  • Connaître le budget alloué au département et plus généralement à la House, gérer le revenu des espaces de ventes restauration du Soho House Paris
  • Optimiser les revenus du département restauration et faire des propositions pour augmenter les revenus des points de vente en fonction des évènements de la House, des évènements sur Paris et des saisons
  • S’assurer de la bonne continuité des opérations des espaces de restauration (revenus, personnel, membres, etc.) et favoriser un climat de coopération et de respect dans ces espaces
  • Être en charge de la coordination entre tous les départements et plus particulièrement entre le Club, le Bar et les Evènements
  • Superviser et faire le suivi des approvisionnements, des commandes, des stocks et des inventaires en vue de respecter le budget alloué et les « costs »
  • Être en mesure d’expliquer les ventes, les chiffres d’affaires et les écarts stocks-inventaires pour les rapports financiers hebdomadaires et mensuels
  • Veiller à atteindre les objectifs financiers alloués aux espaces restauration, à les dépasser et être capable d’apporter des solutions en cas de retards financiers
  • Connaître les différents coûts et dépenses des espaces de restauration pour faire le suivi avec le département Financier et la Direction
  • Elaborer conjointement avec la Direction du Soho House Paris et la Direction Financière le budget du département restauration
  • Calculer et connaître les besoins en cours et futurs en termes d’équipements, ustensiles et linges, superviser les commandes
  • Être en charge des projets des espaces restauration, du suivi et de l’avancé des projets (concepts éphémères, soirées exceptionnelles, animations saisonnières, etc.)
  • Superviser la relation des équipes de la restauration avec les membres en veillant à ce que les commentaires, les avis et feedbacks soient pris en compte en vue d’assurer une offre de service satisfaisante pour la clientèle
  • Faire part à sa hiérarchie des retours de la clientèle et des équipes, proposer des améliorations, des solutions en fonction des points mentionnés
  • Connaître et appliquer quotidiennement les règles en matière de normes HACCP, de régimes alimentaires et allergènes, et les règles liées à la consommation d’alcool tout en respectant les législations en vigueur
  • Maîtriser les standards et techniques de services tout en ayant une connaissance accrue des produits, des recettes
  • Connaître les fournisseurs, leurs tarifs et leurs offres, rechercher de nouveaux fournisseurs pour négocier les tarifs
  • Mettre en place et conduire les formations pour les équipes supervisées et les équipes de la House en coordonnant la mise en place des formations mensuelles « Cook House» et « House Tonic » ainsi que les formations techniques de service et autres formations dispensées par Soho House et Soho House Paris
  • Assister à toutes les dégustations des menus élaborés par le Chef Exécutif, collaborer avec le Chef Exécutif sur les menus en proposants des conseils avisés et faire un retour constructif à la Direction quant aux dégustations, saisonnalités des produits, qualités des produits et retours éventuels des membres
  • S’assurer et effectuer les contrôles et les inspections des installations et équipements techniques des espaces restauration, de sécurité et coordonner avec le département de la Maintenance pour maintenir les équipements et matériels en bon état (réparations, installations de nouvel équipement, contrôles préventifs, etc.)
  • Coordonner la mise en place des briefings quotidiens avec les équipes restauration pour améliorer la communication des les services, organiser une réunion mensuelle avec les équipes encadrantes de la restauration pour transmettre les informations et les projets à venir au sein du département et de la House
  • Se tenir informé(e) des rapports « Mystery Guest » et audits internes pour agir sur les axes d’amélioration et faire un retour aux équipes
  • Veillez à ce que les règles en matière de santé et de sécurité, pour le département de la Restauration soient respectées à tout moment
  • Superviser avec les responsables du Club et du Bar la mise en place et l’application des procédures internes propres aux espaces de restauration en respectant les normes HACCP, d’hygiène et de sécurité
  • Connaître les règles de planification du personnel, faire le suivi des équipes (administratif et disciplinaire) et des absences et coordonner avec le département People & Development pour l’élaboration de la Paie, l’arrivée des nouveaux membres de l’équipe et des rapports de fin de mois
  • Savoir s’exprimer en public et entretenir un bon relationnel avec les équipes et les membres

Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus. raw.title: Project Manager - Avionics, GNC & Flight Software
raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Avionics, Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC), and Flight Software (FSW) functions are central to the safe and reliable operation of the vehicle. Together, they provide the electronic systems, control capabilities and software that guide Nyx through its mission - from launch and on-orbit operations to docking, re-entry and recovery.

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Project Manager — Avionics, GNC & Flight Software to coordinate the development and delivery of these critical domains within the Nyx program.

Your Mission

As Project Manager for Avionics, GNC and Flight Software, you will be responsible for coordinating the execution of these work packages and ensuring that their development remains aligned with the overall Nyx program objectives.

You will work closely with Avionics, GNC and FSW technical leads, systems engineering, propulsion, mission operations, verification and integration teams. Your role will be to create transparency on scope, schedule, interfaces, risks and decisions, while supporting the teams in delivering robust and well-verified capabilities for the vehicle.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys working at the interface between technical teams, program management and mission execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and coordinate the project planning for the Avionics, GNC and FSW work packages within the Nyx program.

  • Translate program objectives and major milestones into clear plans, priorities and deliverables for the relevant teams.

  • Coordinate the development lifecycle from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, integration, verification and release across Avionics, GNC and FSW.

  • Maintain visibility of scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, opportunities and resource needs across the Avionics, GNC and FSW activities.

  • Coordinate closely with the Avionics, GNC and FSW technical leads to monitor progress, identify blockers and support timely decisions.

  • Ensure that technical, program and interface dependencies between Avionics, GNC, FSW, systems engineering, propulsion and mission operations are identified and actively managed.

  • Support the planning and execution of avionics integration, software and hardware-in-the-loop activities, simulations, system integration and mission rehearsals.

  • Coordinate inputs to design reviews, development reviews, qualification activities and other program milestones.

  • Track the preparation and closure of requirements, verification activities, test results, documentation and technical actions.

  • Identify schedule and delivery risks early, define mitigation actions with the relevant owners and escalate unresolved issues when required.

  • Support the management of changes to scope, requirements, interfaces and priorities, ensuring that their impacts are understood.

  • Prepare clear progress updates, decision material and status reports for program and project reviews.

  • Facilitate regular coordination meetings and ensure that actions, decisions and commitments are recorded and followed through.

  • Contribute to resource and capacity planning for the GNC and FSW activities.

  • Support coordination with external partners, suppliers and customers when relevant to the project scope.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of project-management processes, planning practices and reporting routines within the Nyx program.

What You Bring

  • Experience in project or program management within aerospace, space systems, aviation, automotive, robotics, embedded systems or another safety and reliability critical environment.

  • A good understanding of spacecraft avionics, GNC, flight software, embedded software or closely related technical domains.

  • Experience coordinating complex technical work packages involving multiple teams and interfaces.

  • Practical experience managing plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, actions and technical deliverables.

  • The ability to understand technical topics sufficiently to ask the right questions, identify impacts and support informed decisions.

  • Experience working across requirements, design, implementation, integration, testing and verification activities.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to bring structure and transparency to complex projects.

  • A proactive approach to identifying risks, raising issues early and driving actions to closure.

  • The ability to work effectively with technical experts while maintaining focus on program objectives and delivery commitments.

  • Experience with project-management, planning, requirements-management or engineering tools.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in aerospace engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, project management or a related field.

  • Professional fluency in English. Additional European languages are a plus.

What Makes You Special

You are technically curious and comfortable working with experts in avionics, GNC, flight software and other disciplines. You can move between detailed technical discussions and program-level decision-making without losing sight of the overall objective.

You bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. You are proactive in identifying dependencies and risks, clear in your communication and persistent in following actions through to closure. You know how to challenge constructively, support technical teams and escalate decisions when the program needs clarity.

You are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a complex space vehicle and understand that reliable GNC and flight software are built through close collaboration, disciplined engineering and continuous verification.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll have the opportunity to deepen your GL, P2P, and close expertise while gradually expanding into AR and revenue accounting as we grow. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps . Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of. Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes. Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps ! As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You’ll Do As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox. In this role, you can expect to: Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks. Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality. Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base. Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence. Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services. Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity. Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services. Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront). Experience building mapping and geospatial related products. Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub. Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs. Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented. An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings. A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion. A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production. Nice to Have Traits for This Role Proficiency in C++ What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How we support you Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Dein Profil Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze) PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1 Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter. Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin

Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)

  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

title: (Senior) Strategic Partner Manager:in (m|w|d)
description: idealo arbeitet mit einem breiten Spektrum des E-Commerce-Marktes zusammen - von internationalen Plattformen und großen Onlinehändlern bis hin zu Affiliate-Netzwerken, Agenturen und Technologiepartnern. Im Mittelpunkt dieser Rolle steht die strategische Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung relevanter Affiliate-Advertiser. Du entwickelst bestehendes Geschäft, erschließt neue Umsatz- und Wachstumspotenziale, auch über ergänzende Lösungen wie Retail Media, und gestaltest langfristig erfolgreiche Partnerschaften. Ergänzend entwickelst Du die Zusammenarbeit mit Netzwerken, Agenturen und weiteren Multiplikatoren weiter, um zusätzliche Geschäftspotenziale zu erschließen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest und entwickelst Dein Account-Portfolio eigenständig und priorisierst Deine Aktivitäten nach wirtschaftlichem Potenzial und strategischer Relevanz. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Deinen Partnern auf, verstehst ihre Geschäftsmodelle und entwickelst daraus konkrete Wachstums-, Monetarisierungs- und Cross-Selling-Ansätze. Du trägst Verantwortung für Umsatz und Profitabilität Deiner Accounts und führst Vertrags- und Konditionsverhandlungen eigenständig. Du steuerst Deine Partnerschaften datenbasiert anhand relevanter KPIs wie GMV, Conversion Rate, CPO/CPC, Approval- und Stornoquote und leitest daraus Optimierungs-, Skalierungs- und Verhandlungsansätze ab. Du identifizierst zusätzliche Potenziale, z. B. über Retail Media, Sortimentsentwicklung oder strategische Projekte, und setzt diese gemeinsam mit Partnern und internen Expert:innen um. Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Tech, Operations, Analytics, Retail Media und weiteren Sales-Bereichen zusammen. Ergänzend entwickelst Du Kooperationen mit Affiliate-Netzwerken, Agenturen und Technologiepartnern, um zusätzliche Advertiser und skalierbare Geschäftspotenziale zu erschließen. Das bringst du mit Du übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Themen eigenständig voran. Du verfügst über mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung im Partner Management, (Key) Account Management oder beratungsorientierten Vertrieb und hast bereits eigenständig kommerziell relevante Accounts verantwortet. Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für E-Commerce und Performance Marketing mit und kannst Kennzahlen wie CPO, CPC, CVR, KUR, Umsatz und Marge sicher für kommerzielle Entscheidungen nutzen. Erfahrung mit Affiliate Marketing oder Retail Media ist ein Plus. Du kannst anhand konkreter Beispiele zeigen, wie Du Partnerbeziehungen entwickelt und Umsatz, Profitabilität oder strategischen Mehrwert gesteigert hast. Du verbindest ausgeprägtes Account Management mit analytischem und kommerziellem Denken und kannst Partner überzeugend für neue Lösungen gewinnen. Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und trittst souverän gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Entscheidungsebenen auf. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert und setzt auch bei mehreren Accounts und Projekten klare Prioritäten. Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, ist von Vorteil. Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien? Keine Sorge, wir suchen Mitarbeiter:innen, die uns mit ihrer Persönlichkeit überzeugen und motiviert sind, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team alles zu geben! Bei idealo erwartet dich Du willst dich weiterbilden? Wir nehmen deine persönlichen Entwicklungsziele ernst und bieten dir neben unserem idealo Learning Hub, eLearning Angeboten (z.B. Udemy), Coachings & Mediation auch die Möglichkeit individuell von unserem Weiterbildungsbudget zu profitieren. Und was kann das Büro? Unser Büro, im Herzen Berlins, bietet neben dem “Standard-Kicker” auch hervorragendes kostenfreies Mittagessen, sowie kostenfreien Kaffee, Limonade und Feierabend-Bier. Dabei kannst du auf unserer wunderschönen Dachterrasse mit Kolleg:innen aus unserer Unternehmensgruppe netzwerken. Du wünschst dir Unterstützung auch außerhalb der Arbeit? Eine kostenlose Beratung, sowie Unterstützung in allen Lebenslagen (beruflich, privat, familiär, gesundheitlich etc.) bieten wir in Zusammenarbeit mit dem pme-Familienservice . Du willst auch mobil sein? Mit Job-Bike oder Deutschlandticket kein Problem – und das ist auch noch umweltfreundlich! Du möchtest dich fit halten? Hierzu bieten wir dir viele unterschiedliche Fitness- und Sportmöglichkeiten wie zum Beispiel eine Urban Sports oder Gympass Mitgliedschaft für deine ganz persönlichen Bedürfnisse an. Und was gibt es noch? Selbstverständlich müssen Erfolge gefeiert werden! Neben Team-Events erwarten dich auch große Company-Events, bei denen wir keine Kosten und Mühen scheuen. #LI-MR1 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions N2F et Keeple s’imposent comme des références sur le marché français. Ta mission sera de garantir la qualité de nos solutions pour assurer la satisfaction de nos clients. Tes principales missions seront : Concevoir des scénarios de tests à partir des analyses rédigées par les équipes produit, Exécuter les cas de test fonctionnels sur différentes versions de notre logiciel, Identifier, qualifier les anomalies, et suivre leur correction en collaboration directe avec les développeurs, Réaliser des tests de non-régression et collaborer avec nos automaticiens afin d’augmenter la couverture de nos tests automatisés, Suivre et documenter les résultats des tests, Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions qualité, préventives ou correctives, S’assurer en permanence des bonnes performances du logiciel, Faire le lien entre les équipes consulting/support et développement. title: Senior RF Engineer
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You will be the technical authority for RF hardware behind Dedrone's airspace security products — the RF detection sensors that find and classify drones, and the countermeasure systems that defeat them. You own the hard RF problems end to end: wideband receive chains, high-power transmit chains, and their physical realization on board. You do not carry direct reports, but you technically lead a group of RF hardware engineers and antenna designers — you set the standards they design to, review their work, and grow their capability. This is a hands-on role. You will spend real time in simulation, on the bench, and in the chamber.

What You'll Do

Location: This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: Director RF Engineering

  • Own RF front-end architecture from VHF through SHF: link budgets, frequency planning, spurious and intermodulation analysis, sensitivity and dynamic-range trade-offs.
  • Design and characterize mixers, high-power amplifiers, filters, and switching networks against demanding linearity, efficiency, and thermal targets.
  • Drive board-level simulation (EM, circuit, and co-simulation) and take designs through multi-layer RF PCB layout, stack-up definition, and fabrication release.
  • Lead bring-up, characterization, and design-for-test; close the loop between simulated and measured performance.
  • Set and enforce RF design standards, review checklists, and documentation practice across the group.
  • Mentor RF HW engineers and antenna designers; raise the technical bar through design reviews rather than rework.
  • Partner with DSP, software, mechanical, and systems engineering, and with regulatory/compliance on CE, FCC, and MIL-STD qualification.
  • Advise leadership on technology direction, build-vs-buy, and technical risk.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in RF hardware design, with a track record of products shipped to volume.
  • Deep expertise across VHF, UHF, and SHF — not just one band.
  • Demonstrated design ownership of mixers and high-power amplifiers above 10 W.
  • Strong command of RF simulation tooling — EM and circuit solvers (e.g. ADS, AWR, HFSS, CST) — and the judgment to know when simulation is telling you the truth.
  • Multi-layer RF PCB design: controlled impedance, material selection, grounding, isolation, thermal management.
  • Fluent with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power measurement; comfortable debugging from first principles.
  • Proven technical leadership of a design group — setting direction and standards, mentoring, running rigorous design reviews.
  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent.

Nice to have

  • Antenna design and integration — element and array design, platform effects, radiation-pattern measurement.
  • Direction-finding techniques (amplitude/phase comparison, interferometry, TDOA, AoA estimation).
  • Beamforming across approaches: analog, digital, and hybrid; phased arrays and adaptive/null-steering methods.
  • Hands-on experience with SDR platforms.
  • Experience developing and qualifying products for regulated markets — CE, FCC, and/or MIL-STD.
  • Working knowledge of DSP concepts sufficient to trade functionality between analog and digital domains.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. title: Frontend Architect
description: About The Job Navan is an all-in-one travel, corporate card, and expense management solution that eliminates the hassles of corporate travel & expense management while giving finance leaders real-time spend visibility and control. The Frontend Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of Navan's frontend infrastructure and developer experience across the organization. This role is central to architecting and maintaining the frontend platform that enables 20+ engineering teams to deploy independently while maintaining high quality standards. The Frontend Architect is essential to our mission, building shared libraries, developer tooling, and infrastructure, evolving the platform for both human and AI-assisted development, and driving performance and reliability initiatives. What You'll Do Architect Micro-Frontend Infrastructure: Design and evolve micro-frontend platform using Module Federation in React & Angular. Create and maintain shared NPM packages enforcing consistency and patterns across the organization. Drive team collaboration through architectural governance, review processes, and cross-functional alignment. Drive Developer Platform Strategy: Create developer tools and automation that streamline workflows and boost productivity across engineering teams. Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for frontend implementation, browser testing, debugging, framework migrations, and delivery—from a task specification to a validated pull request. Author technical documentation and mentor engineers through code reviews. Enable Reliable Coding Agent Workflows: Structure repositories, component libraries, documentation, and development environments so engineers and coding agents can reliably build, test, and extend the platform. Establish clear component contracts, runnable examples, predictable build and test commands, and reusable skills and integrations that provide relevant company context and actionable validation feedback. Establish Shared Patterns for AI-Powered Experiences: Partner with product and AI platform teams to establish shared UI patterns for AI-powered experiences, including streaming responses, progress visibility, cancellation, error recovery, and user approval of consequential actions. Design reusable components with clear contracts that reduce integration time across teams. Strengthen Testing and Validation: Establish fast, reliable feedback through component tests, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI gates so changes can be validated consistently across teams. Define validation and human review requirements for AI-generated changes. Drive Adoption and Measurable Outcomes: Pilot new workflows with engineering teams, measure delivery time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage cost, and turn successful approaches into supported company standards. Verify that tools, integrations, and workflows operate successfully in the teams and environments where they are adopted. Partner on Secure AI-Assisted Development: Work with Security and the AI platform team to establish scoped tool access, safe handling of secrets and sensitive data, and clear accountability for agent-generated changes. Define appropriate human review and approval boundaries for frontend workflows. Drive Reliability & Performance: Lead optimization initiatives to reduce bundle size and costs. Spearhead framework migrations delivering critical security fixes. Implement performance monitoring and optimization strategies that reduce latency and improve load times. What We're Looking For At least 8 years of experience in frontend software development At least 3 years of experience in frontend architecture with demonstrated organization-wide impact Deep expertise with React and TypeScript; experience with Angular is highly valued Experience with micro-frontend architectures (Module Federation, single-spa, Web Components, or similar approaches) Strong knowledge of build tooling (Webpack, Vite, Rollup) and monorepo management Experience with testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and establishing testing standards across teams, including component testing, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI validation Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver production changes, with the ability to evaluate generated code, design effective validation, and explain where human review is necessary Ability to demonstrate improvements in engineering delivery, quality, or reliability from AI-assisted workflows and drive adoption across teams Practical understanding of scoped tool access, secrets, sensitive data, and accountability for AI-generated changes, in partnership with Security and AI platform teams Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and drive consensus across multiple teams. Nice to have: Experience with observability platforms, CDN optimization, Next.js or other meta-frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter. Pay Range $129,600—$288,000 USD Navan uses AI-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. Human oversight: Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application. Your rights: If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here . Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

  • Enable Reliable Coding Agent Workflows: Structure repositories, component libraries, documentation, and development environments so engineers and coding agents can reliably build, test, and extend the platform. Establish clear component contracts, runnable examples, predictable build and test commands, and reusable skills and integrations that provide relevant company context and actionable validation feedback.
  • Establish Shared Patterns for AI-Powered Experiences: Partner with product and AI platform teams to establish shared UI patterns for AI-powered experiences, including streaming responses, progress visibility, cancellation, error recovery, and user approval of consequential actions. Design reusable components with clear contracts that reduce integration time across teams.
  • Strengthen Testing and Validation: Establish fast, reliable feedback through component tests, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI gates so changes can be validated consistently across teams. Define validation and human review requirements for AI-generated changes.
  • Drive Adoption and Measurable Outcomes: Pilot new workflows with engineering teams, measure delivery time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage cost, and turn successful approaches into supported company standards. Verify that tools, integrations, and workflows operate successfully in the teams and environments where they are adopted.
  • Partner on Secure AI-Assisted Development: Work with Security and the AI platform team to establish scoped tool access, safe handling of secrets and sensitive data, and clear accountability for agent-generated changes. Define appropriate human review and approval boundaries for frontend workflows.
  • Drive Reliability & Performance: Lead optimization initiatives to reduce bundle size and costs. Spearhead framework migrations delivering critical security fixes. Implement performance monitoring and optimization strategies that reduce latency and improve load times.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 8 years of experience in frontend software development
  • At least 3 years of experience in frontend architecture with demonstrated organization-wide impact
  • Deep expertise with React and TypeScript; experience with Angular is highly valued
  • Experience with micro-frontend architectures (Module Federation, single-spa, Web Components, or similar approaches)
  • Strong knowledge of build tooling (Webpack, Vite, Rollup) and monorepo management
  • Experience with testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and establishing testing standards across teams, including component testing, browser automation, visual regression checks, and CI validation
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver production changes, with the ability to evaluate generated code, design effective validation, and explain where human review is necessary
  • Ability to demonstrate improvements in engineering delivery, quality, or reliability from AI-assisted workflows and drive adoption across teams
  • Practical understanding of scoped tool access, secrets, sensitive data, and accountability for AI-generated changes, in partnership with Security and AI platform teams
  • Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and drive consensus across multiple teams.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Platform Engineer 

À propos du rôle et de l'équipe

La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) est une Business Unit de près de 200 personnes qui continue de se renforcer pour accompagner les ambitions tech de Decathlon. Notre objectif principal est de rationaliser le catalogue de produits techniques et de fournir des services clé en main pour les équipes IT, afin de leur permettre de se concentrer sur le développement de fonctionnalités à fort impact applicatif.

Au sein de la CPE, tu rejoindras l'équipe Cloud Dev. Notre mission est de fournir des fonctionnalités essentielles et abstraites pour le Cloud, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de développement d'ingénierie logicielle pour unifier, sécuriser et optimiser nos plateformes.

Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d'Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d'automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport !

Périmètre et missions d'un Platform Engineer

En tant que Platform Engineer, tu joueras un rôle central dans l'autonomisation des équipes de développement grâce à l'ingénierie de plateforme. Tes missions s'articuleront autour des piliers suivants :

1. Ingénierie Logicielle & Abstraction Cloud

  • Utiliser les meilleures pratiques de développement (Software Engineering, Software Architecture) pour concevoir du code propre, robuste et maintenable créant des couches d'abstraction au-dessus du Cloud.
  • Développer et industrialiser des API, outils internes et modules d'infrastructure en Python et Go.
  • Consommer et orchestrer des services Serverless (Google Cloud Functions, Google Workflows) et moderniser l'outillage de déploiement.

2. Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation DevSecOps

  • Concevoir, tester et déployer l'infrastructure de manière cohérente et automatisée avec Terraform.
  • Construire et optimiser des pipelines CI/CD modernes (de préférence avec GitHub Actions) intégrant les standards de sécurité DevSecOps dès la conception.
  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes par du scripting (Python, Bash) afin de réduire l'effort manuel et maximiser la fiabilité.

3. Intégration Transversale & Excellence Opérationnelle

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Réseau, Sécurité et Bases de données pour garantir des intégrations fluides, performantes et sécurisées.
  • Rôle de Run Captain: prendre en charge le support de niveau 2/3, l'analyse des incidents et le traitement des demandes de service pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle.
  • Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLO/SLI ainsi qu'à la démarche de réduction du MTTR en automatisant la résolution des problèmes récurrents.

4. Accompagnement, Partage & Culture Produit

  • Rédiger une documentation technique propre et des guides utilisateurs pour faciliter l'adoption des services de plateforme.
  • Sensibiliser et former les équipes techniques aux bonnes pratiques d'utilisation des composants développés.
  • Participer à l'animation collective via la gestion agile de nos livrables dans JIRA et promouvoir le partage de connaissances au sein de l'équipe.

Ce dont tu auras besoin pour réussir

  • Expérience & Dév : Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python avec une solide maîtrise des pratiques modernes de génie logiciel.
  • Expertise Cloud : Fortes compétences et expérience avérée sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD : Maîtrise de Terraform et très bonne pratique des pipelines CI/CD (idéalement GitHub Actions).
  • Scripting & Serverless : Bonne connaissance de l'automatisation (Python, Bash) et de l'architecture Serverless / événementielle.
  • Soft Skills & Esprit d'équipe : Excellent relationnel, fort sens de la satisfaction client/utilisateur interne, rigueur dans la documentation et aisance pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
  • Langues : Anglais maîtrisé à l'oral comme à l'écrit, niveau B2 minimum.
  • Un plus apprécié : Connaissance pour le langage Go, l'utilisation de Google Workflows ou une certification GCP (Associate Cloud Engineer ou Professional Cloud Developer).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Esprit d'équipe & Sport : Une communauté sportive passionnée et du temps dédié à la pratique du sport.
  • Cadre de travail : Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Paris ou Lille et 2 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Environnement de travail : Du matériel récent en accord avec tes missions et tes besoins techniques.
  • Opportunités & Mobilité : Une équipe locale au sein d'un réseau mondial, offrant des possibilités de carrière à l'international.
  • Développement professionnel : Accompagnement continu dans le développement de tes compétences (diversité des projets, certifications, formations internes et externes…).
  • Package de rémunération : Package attractif incluant la participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise ainsi que des bonus mensuels, trimestriels et annuels.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

description:
Notre équipe Data Governance recherche un·e Data Governance Project Manager basé·e à Lille 

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. 

Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client Notre défi ? La rendre gouvernée, sûre et accessible à tous. 

Tu rejoindras le Data Governance Center of Excellence pour transformer nos politiques théoriques en réalités opérationnelles. Ta mission est double : Améliorer les dispositifs de contrôles de la données et garantir la conformité de nos actifs via un framework d’audit robuste. 

TA MISSION : ORGANISER LA STRATEGIE D'AUDIT ET DE CONTRÔLE DE NOS STANDARDS DE GOUVERNANCE

1. Stratégie d’Audit & Compliance

Ton rôle est de mesurer la conformité de l'organisation à nos standards de gouvernance sur l’intégralité de notre scope. 

  • Framework de Contrôle vs Audit : Définir la ligne de démarcation entre le contrôle continu (opérationnel/automatique) et l'audit périodique (stratégique/qualitatif).
  • Industrialisation : Identifier les contrôles éligibles à l’automatisation (ex: intégrité référentielle, fraîcheur via les Data Contracts) et piloter leur mise en œuvre avec les équipes Data Engineering.
  • Audit des "Invisibles" : Concevoir les protocoles(y compris plan d’audit, cartographie des risques et déclenchement de mission ad hoc) d'audit pour les critères non-automatisables (pertinence du dictionnaire de données, qualité des descriptions, respect des processus de classification Privacy), identifier les root cause, les risques et les responsabilités.
  • Gestion des non conformités : Définir la stratégie de suivi des écarts. Tu ne te contentes pas de pointer les problèmes, tu bâtis le framework qui aide les équipes à corriger le tir (scoring, plans d'actions, escalade).

2. Structuration

Tu jouera pleinement ton rôle dans la définition et dans l’amélioration continue de l’operating modèle des audits et des contrôles

  • Mandat : Faire valider le niveau de sponsor et de validation du mandat général et/ou des fiches de mission pour assurer le bon niveau d’engagement des audités. Les décisions devront s’articuler autour du cadre général d’Audit interne de Decathlon
  • Reporting : Communiquer les résultats des travaux et assurer le suivi de la mise en oeuvre des recommandations et, le cas échéant, du processus d’escalade
  • Interactions : Formaliser et faire vivre les rituels et procédures permettant d’optimiser les synergies entre les travaux d’audit et de contrôle et ceux des autres équipes de la gouvernance fédérée (Expertise & projets de CoE en particulier)

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Culture de l'Audit & de la Conformité : Tu as une solide expérience dans la définition de standards, de normes et de protocoles d'audit. Tu sais distinguer un contrôle opérationnel d'un audit de gouvernance et tu es capable de transformer un constat d'écart en un plan de remédiation pragmatique (KRI/KPI)
  • Leadership d'Influence & Change : Tu es à l’aise dans l'animation de communautés (Data Stewards, Producers). Tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, lever les points de friction entre technique et business, et porter une vision de "Gouvernance by design"

Das gelingt dir durch dein tiefes Verständnis der Conversion Rates und Mechaniken im Funnel sowie der übergeordneten Customer Journey. Experimente und Funnel-Hebel: Du identifizierst Kampagnenansätze für bislang ungenutzte Zielgruppensegmente und Lücken im Funnel. Hypothesen zu Kanalmix und Messaging überführst du in konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen. Die Erkenntnisse teilst du strukturiert im Team, damit sie in die nächsten Kampagnen einfließen. Erfolgsmessung und Dokumentation: Du steuerst deine Kampagnen über KPIs wie Net New Money, CAC und Effektivität. Entscheidungen, Annahmen und Learnings dokumentierst du systematisch, sodass sie für das Team nachvollziehbar und wiederverwendbar sind. Das bringst du mit Background Du verfügst über mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem dynamischen Umfeld, idealerweise in FinTech, Strategieberatung, Banking oder einem Unternehmen mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten. Du hast digitale Akquisitions-Funnels und Multi-Channel-Kampagnen über Paid, Owned und Earned konzipiert und gesteuert. Du bringst Erfahrung und eine persönliche Affinität zum Thema Geldanlage mit. Skills & Fähigkeiten Du formulierst Briefings, die Spezialist:innen der Fachbereiche schnell umsetzen können, und bewertest deren Ergebnisse fachlich fundiert. Du denkst datenbasiert: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie und übersetzt Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Maßnahmen. Dabei bist du analytisch exzellent und detailverliebt. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit relevanten Tools wie HubSpot, Salesforce, Braze und Analytics-Plattformen. Du koordinierst abteilungsübergreifend, auch ohne formale Weisungsbefugnis, und hältst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen. Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, gegenüber Fachteams ebenso wie auf C‑Level. Mindset Du ziehst deine Motivation aus dem Erfolg deiner Kampagnen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Zielerreichung. Du gestaltest Strukturen und Prozesse in einer Transformationsphase aktiv mit und gehst Themen proaktiv an. Du gibst und nimmst fachliches Feedback und argumentierst auf C‑Level diplomatisch und durchsetzungsstark. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung! Das bieten wir dir Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500 €. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall. Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Case Study: Du zeigst uns anhand eines realistischen Szenarios, wie du eine Wachstumskampagne konzipierst, steuerst und auswertest. Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Investments und Vertrieb. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. title: Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will contribute to the definition and development of key aircraft mechanical systems, including the Environmental Control System, landing gear, ice protection, interiors and other mechanical systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft. Your Day-to-Day: Define and derive system-level requirements for mechanical aircraft systems based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations. Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces. Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase. Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines. Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems. Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements. Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities. Your Profile: Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems. Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration. Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear. Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification. Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus. Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment. Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight. Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems. Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme. Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for one or more mechanical systems on a CS-23 aircraft programme. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation. We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments. Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us. Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days. Become a part of our success with virtual stock options. Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket. Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability. Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security. Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft. Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects. Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports). VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. London or Remote (UK) | £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits

About the Role

This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.

Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at:

  • Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work :

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. ✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)
Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)
At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind.

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process.
