title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons
description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: addons.mozilla.org (AMO) is the foundation of the Firefox add-ons ecosystem. It’s a showcase for developers to publish and grow their extensions, and a place of discovery for millions of users who customize Firefox to make it their own. Behind the scenes are the DevHub which enables developers to manage their extensions. To manage the ecosystem there are a series of Reviewer tools and automated moderation systems. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll bring a passion for crafting resilient systems that accelerate our review and moderation teams to provide a first-class experience for Add-on developers. You’ll work closely with engineers, reviewers, developer support, and Add-ons leadership to turn ideas into polished features, modernize the platform and its architecture, and see your work reach millions of people around the world. What you’ll do: Deliver major features and architectural improvements across the Add-ons stack, including automated moderation pipelines, Reviewer tools, and DevHub. Help establish and maintain engineering standards across areas such as code review, definition of done, production readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call practices, coding conventions, and infrastructure as code. Create robust observability systems and data-backed insights. Provide peer feedback, share knowledge and help others grow. Build and improve the systems that enable Add-ons engineering to safely develop, deploy, observe, and operate production services. Improve our CI/CD pipelines using declarative, pipeline-as-code approaches that make changes reproducible, testable, and easy to review. Deliver work iteratively using a visible backlog, short feedback cycles, retrospectives, and demonstrations to stakeholders. Write clear technical documentation, including design notes, Architecture Decision Records, runbooks, and incident write-ups. Work effectively in unfamiliar codebases, tracing requests and asynchronous jobs end-to-end to understand failures and identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with designers, product managers, QA, and community contributors to deliver end-to-end improvements. Contribute in the open through pull requests, code reviews, and discussions. Work on: Feature development: submission flows, trust and safety signals, DevHub and Reviewer tools modernization. AMO application systems: Work within our Python/Django, MySQL, React/TypeScript, and asynchronous processing systems. Internal developer platforms : Create tools and paved paths that make it easier for teams to ship and operate software safely and consistently. Team Process: Contribute to team ceremonies, execute process improvement, and provide feedback on team effectiveness. Engineering standards : Help make production readiness, testing, recoverability, documentation, and safe deployment part of the normal development lifecycle. Platform reliability: Deployments, monitoring, and incident response. What you’ll bring: Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications with Python/Django. Experience operating and improving production software systems where reliability and safe delivery matter. Strong experience with CI/CD systems and treating pipelines and infrastructure declaratively as code. Experience designing or improving automated testing and deployment workflows, including integration testing and staged or progressive delivery. Strong understanding of observability as an engineering discipline, including metrics, logging, tracing, service-level objectives, and actionable alerting. Experience building or maintaining internal tools or platforms used by other engineering teams, with an understanding that internal systems have users, reliability expectations, roadmaps, and lifecycle considerations. Experience defining or improving engineering practices such as code review standards, operational readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call expectations, or definitions of done. Ability to read and understand unfamiliar codebases and trace application behavior across frontend, backend, asynchronous jobs, data stores, and infrastructure. Experience debugging complex production issues and turning what you learn into lasting system improvements. Strong technical writing skills, with experience creating useful documentation such as design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and incident reports. Experience working iteratively with a visible backlog, regular stakeholder feedback, and retrospectives that result in concrete improvements. Strong collaboration and communication skills in a distributed team environment. A willingness to share knowledge and mentor peers in operational and reliability practices. Commitment to our values: Welcoming differences Being relationship-minded Practicing responsible participation Having grit Bonus points for: Experience with Google Cloud and operating Kubernetes. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and policy-as-code. Experience establishing SLOs and error-budget-based reliability practices. Experience with chaos engineering, disaster recovery testing, or production readiness reviews. Experience with trust and safety, automated moderation, abuse prevention, or other adversarial systems. Contributions to open source projects What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. In the first month, expect to: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down. Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented. Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result. In the first six months, expect to: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it. Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most. In the first year, expect to: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering. Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale. Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up. Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work. Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence. Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers. Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for. You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI. Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar. Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale. Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield. Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.   • Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
  • Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
  • Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
  • Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
  • Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
  • Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
  • Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
  • You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
  • Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
  • Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
  • Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

title: Chief Architect
description: Chief Architect Remote - US Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation. This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems. This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity. The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it. This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO. Responsibilities and Duties Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution. Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction. Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization. Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction. Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability. Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk. Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning. Platform Architecture and Technical Vision Define and own the long-term architecture for Legion’s AI-driven Workforce Management platform across application services, data infrastructure, ML systems, optimization engines, APIs, integration architecture, developer platforms, and enterprise-scale operations. Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability. Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences. Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities. Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues. Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed. Ensure Legion’s architecture supports enterprise configurability and extensibility without allowing uncontrolled customization or product fragmentation. AI, Optimization, and Decision Systems Architect AI-native product capabilities across forecasting, scheduling, labor optimization, recommendations, copilots or agents, anomaly detection, decision automation, and other intelligent workforce management use cases. Define the architecture for production AI systems, including data pipelines, feature platforms, model training, model serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, feedback loops, and continuous improvement. Make clear build-versus-buy decisions across LLMs, classical ML, optimization solvers, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and internal AI platforms. Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to turn mathematically complex labor optimization problems into reliable, scalable, explainable production systems. Establish standards for AI system quality, including accuracy, latency, cost, explainability, drift detection, reliability, customer-specific behavior, and production observability. Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features. Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations. Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics. Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence. Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement. Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage. Product, Business, and Customer Impact Connect technical decisions directly to customer value, product velocity, implementation speed, scalability, reliability, and long-term platform advantage. Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambitious product goals into executable architecture and technical roadmaps. Understand enterprise customer complexity and design systems that support real-world operational variability without creating unsustainable technical debt. Support strategic customer, partner, and vendor architecture discussions where deep technical credibility is required. Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions. Engineering Culture and Technical Talent Mentor and elevate Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, architects, and senior engineering leaders across the organization. Raise the bar for technical judgment, system design, architecture reviews, documentation, code quality, operational discipline, and engineering craftsmanship. Help assess, attract, and develop senior technical talent, including Staff, Principal, and architect-level engineers. Build a culture of disciplined technical thinking, direct debate, clear decision-making, and pragmatic execution. Ensure architectural decisions are documented clearly, understood broadly, and translated into executable engineering plans. Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Readiness Own the architectural approach to enterprise security, data governance, privacy, compliance, auditability, and resilience. Ensure architecture supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, data residency, access control, tenant isolation, regulatory requirements, and other needs of large global enterprise customers. Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to make security and compliance foundational architectural properties rather than after-the-fact controls. Travel Requirements Up to 15% travel for leadership collaboration, engineering offsites, strategic customer engagements, and other business-critical meetings. Required Skills and Qualifications Experience Level 15+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software systems. Prior experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, very senior Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leadership role. Demonstrated success designing and scaling mission-critical, multi-tenant SaaS platforms for enterprise customers. Deep hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, APIs, event-driven systems, platform engineering, and high-availability production environments. Proven ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can credibly engage in code-level and design-level discussions with senior engineers. Experience making major architecture decisions for systems with high scale, high reliability requirements, complex domain logic, and long product lifecycles. Experience modernizing large production systems incrementally while maintaining uptime, backward compatibility, customer trust, and engineering velocity. Experience building or supporting AI, ML, optimization, decisioning, forecasting, or data-intensive products in production. Strong understanding of observability, incident response, performance engineering, reliability architecture, capacity planning, and operational excellence. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners. Technical Depth Deep expertise in distributed systems, system design, cloud architecture, service-oriented or microservices architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, and large-scale data processing. Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Strong experience with modern engineering practices, including architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, testing strategy, deployment architecture, observability, and production operations. Experience with languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Scala, or similar modern backend languages. Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs involving performance, latency, throughput, cost, reliability, developer productivity, extensibility, and maintainability. Leadership and Judgment Strong architectural judgment: knows when to simplify, when to re-platform, when to tolerate debt, and when to force a hard technical reset. Demonstrated ability to make bold technical decisions with incomplete information and drive alignment across senior technical and executive stakeholders. Ability to influence without relying on hierarchy, while still being willing to make clear decisions when consensus is insufficient. Strong product and business judgment; able to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, implementation speed, product differentiation, and company strategy. Pragmatic builder mindset: balances long-term architecture with startup speed, customer urgency, and execution realities. Preferred Qualifications and Attributes Experience building platforms used by millions of users or supporting very large-scale enterprise operations. Experience at companies known for large-scale distributed systems, AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, workforce management, supply chain, fintech, commerce, logistics, or other complex operational domains. Familiarity with optimization engines, scheduling algorithms, forecasting systems, constraint solvers, real-time decision systems, or mathematically complex production systems. Experience architecting AI-native product capabilities, including LLM-enabled workflows, AI agents or copilots, model evaluation, retrieval systems, feedback loops, and production monitoring. Experience building internal developer platforms, platform infrastructure, data platforms, ML pipelines, or large-scale analytics systems. Experience designing highly configurable enterprise platforms without creating unbounded customization or implementation complexity. Experience participating in strategic customer architecture reviews or technical due diligence with large enterprise customers. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; PhD a plus but not required. Candidate Profile The strongest candidate will be a deeply technical, hands-on architect who still has the range to shape company-level technical direction. They are not a generic enterprise architect, process owner, or strategy-only leader. They are a builder and technical decision-maker who can personally engage with Legion’s hardest problems and earn the respect of the strongest engineers in the company. They should be comfortable moving between: Code and architecture. Product ambition and technical feasibility. AI innovation and production reliability. Startup speed and enterprise-grade rigor. Long-term platform strategy and immediate technical execution. They should be opinionated but not dogmatic, decisive but not reckless, and pragmatic without accepting mediocrity. They should be able to simplify complex systems, identify the real technical risks, and force clarity where teams are stuck in ambiguity. Compensation and Benefits Salary Range: Base Salary Range $300,000- $385,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity. At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region, town, or cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount budgeted internally, and internal equity for the same position within the company. Benefits include, but are not limited to: $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment. 401k plan. Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays. Parental Leave. Equity. Monthly Wellness Reimbursement. Monthly Lunch on Legion. ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. For more information, visit https://legion.co EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. How We Determine What We Pay As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. (“ Legion ”, “ we ”, “ us ” and “ our ”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California. This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies. Types of Personal Information We Handle We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes: Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts. Professional or employment-related information, including: Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references. Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information. Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history. Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application. How We Use Personal Information We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions. With Whom We Share Personal Information We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable): Internally : to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.   • Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability.
  • Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities.
  • Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues.
  • Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed.
  • Ensure Legion’s architecture supports enterprise configurability and extensibility without allowing uncontrolled customization or product fragmentation.

AI, Optimization, and Decision Systems

  • Architect AI-native product capabilities across forecasting, scheduling, labor optimization, recommendations, copilots or agents, anomaly detection, decision automation, and other intelligent workforce management use cases.
  • Define the architecture for production AI systems, including data pipelines, feature platforms, model training, model serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, feedback loops, and continuous improvement.
  • Make clear build-versus-buy decisions across LLMs, classical ML, optimization solvers, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and internal AI platforms.
  • Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to turn mathematically complex labor optimization problems into reliable, scalable, explainable production systems.
  • Establish standards for AI system quality, including accuracy, latency, cost, explainability, drift detection, reliability, customer-specific behavior, and production observability.
  • Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features.

Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale

  • Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations.
  • Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics.
  • Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence.
  • Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement.
  • Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage.

Product, Business, and Customer Impact

  • Connect technical decisions directly to customer value, product velocity, implementation speed, scalability, reliability, and long-term platform advantage.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambitious product goals into executable architecture and technical roadmaps.
  • Understand enterprise customer complexity and design systems that support real-world operational variability without creating unsustainable technical debt.
  • Support strategic customer, partner, and vendor architecture discussions where deep technical credibility is required.
  • Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions.

Engineering Culture and Technical Talent

  • Mentor and elevate Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, architects, and senior engineering leaders across the organization.
  • Raise the bar for technical judgment, system design, architecture reviews, documentation, code quality, operational discipline, and engineering craftsmanship.
  • Help assess, attract, and develop senior technical talent, including Staff, Principal, and architect-level engineers.
  • Build a culture of disciplined technical thinking, direct debate, clear decision-making, and pragmatic execution.
  • Ensure architectural decisions are documented clearly, understood broadly, and translated into executable engineering plans.

Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Readiness

  • Own the architectural approach to enterprise security, data governance, privacy, compliance, auditability, and resilience.
  • Ensure architecture supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, data residency, access control, tenant isolation, regulatory requirements, and other needs of large global enterprise customers.
  • Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to make security and compliance foundational architectural properties rather than after-the-fact controls.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15% travel for leadership collaboration, engineering offsites, strategic customer engagements, and other business-critical meetings.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Experience Level

15+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software systems.Prior experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, very senior Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.

  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling mission-critical, multi-tenant SaaS platforms for enterprise customers.
  • Deep hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, APIs, event-driven systems, platform engineering, and high-availability production environments.
  • Proven ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can credibly engage in code-level and design-level discussions with senior engineers.
  • Experience making major architecture decisions for systems with high scale, high reliability requirements, complex domain logic, and long product lifecycles.
  • Experience modernizing large production systems incrementally while maintaining uptime, backward compatibility, customer trust, and engineering velocity.
  • Experience building or supporting AI, ML, optimization, decisioning, forecasting, or data-intensive products in production.
  • Strong understanding of observability, incident response, performance engineering, reliability architecture, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners.

Technical Depth

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, system design, cloud architecture, service-oriented or microservices architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, and large-scale data processing.
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong experience with modern engineering practices, including architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, testing strategy, deployment architecture, observability, and production operations.
  • Experience with languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Scala, or similar modern backend languages.
  • Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs involving performance, latency, throughput, cost, reliability, developer productivity, extensibility, and maintainability.

Leadership and Judgment

  • Strong architectural judgment: knows when to simplify, when to re-platform, when to tolerate debt, and when to force a hard technical reset.
  • Demonstrated ability to make bold technical decisions with incomplete information and drive alignment across senior technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence without relying on hierarchy, while still being willing to make clear decisions when consensus is insufficient.
  • Strong product and business judgment; able to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, implementation speed, product differentiation, and company strategy.
  • Pragmatic builder mindset: balances long-term architecture with startup speed, customer urgency, and execution realities.

Preferred Qualifications and Attributes

  • Experience building platforms used by millions of users or supporting very large-scale enterprise operations.
  • Experience at companies known for large-scale distributed systems, AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, workforce management, supply chain, fintech, commerce, logistics, or other complex operational domains.
  • Familiarity with optimization engines, scheduling algorithms, forecasting systems, constraint solvers, real-time decision systems, or mathematically complex production systems.
  • Experience architecting AI-native product capabilities, including LLM-enabled workflows, AI agents or copilots, model evaluation, retrieval systems, feedback loops, and production monitoring.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, platform infrastructure, data platforms, ML pipelines, or large-scale analytics systems.
  • Experience designing highly configurable enterprise platforms without creating unbounded customization or implementation complexity.
  • Experience participating in strategic customer architecture reviews or technical due diligence with large enterprise customers.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; PhD a plus but not required.

Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate will be a deeply technical, hands-on architect who still has the range to shape company-level technical direction. They are not a generic enterprise architect, process owner, or strategy-only leader. They are a builder and technical decision-maker who can personally engage with Legion’s hardest problems and earn the respect of the strongest engineers in the company.

They should be comfortable moving between:

  • Code and architecture.
  • Product ambition and technical feasibility.
  • AI innovation and production reliability.
  • Startup speed and enterprise-grade rigor.
  • Long-term platform strategy and immediate technical execution.

They should be opinionated but not dogmatic, decisive but not reckless, and pragmatic without accepting mediocrity. They should be able to simplify complex systems, identify the real technical risks, and force clarity where teams are stuck in ambiguity.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary Range: Base Salary Range $300,000- $385,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity.

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region, town, or cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount budgeted internally, and internal equity for the same position within the company.

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment.
  • 401k plan.
  • Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays.
  • Parental Leave.
  • Equity.
  • Monthly Wellness Reimbursement.
  • Monthly Lunch on Legion.

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

  1. Types of Personal Information We Handle

    We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

    • Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.
    • Professional or employment-related information, including:
      • Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.

  2. How We Use Personal Information

    We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

  3. With Whom We Share Personal Information

  • Implement AI evaluation approaches for LLM outputs, RAG quality, agent behavior, model performance, hallucination detection, safety, and reliability.

  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, data scientists, DevOps, security, and business stakeholders to deliver practical AI solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code.
  • Support production rollouts, troubleshooting, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement of AI systems.
  • Stay current with modern AI technologies, frameworks, models, and engineering practices, and bring practical recommendations to the team.

  • Minimum 7-8 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, data science, or related technical roles.

  • Practical experience with AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM-based applications, tool-calling architectures, workflow automation, and AI orchestration patterns.

  • Strong Python development experience, including experience with Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks.
  • Some experience with React for building user-facing AI tools, internal applications, dashboards, or workflow interfaces.

  • Experience with advanced LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar agent/orchestration frameworks.

  • Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, tools, and techniques for assessing LLM outputs, RAG performance, agent behavior, model quality, safety, reliability, and regression over time.
  • Knowledge or practical experience with RLHF - human-in-the-loop evaluation, preference data, reward modeling, or feedback-driven model improvement.
  • Experience with vector databases and retrieval/search technologies, such as Amazon OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector, or similar.
  • Experience building RAG systems, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval evaluation, reranking, and grounding techniques.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to turn AI prototypes into reliable, maintainable production systems.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Considered as an Advantage

  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock Agents, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, or similar managed AI capabilities.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration, including Docker and EKS/ECS.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on. The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running. Tala is seeking a driven engineer to join our growing Product Development team. The ideal candidate is adept at problem-solving and debugging, and is committed to continuously improving existing systems and processes. You will work closely with fellow Tala engineers to build and extend Tala's backend architecture to support new country launches, new features, and a fast growing user base. The Senior Backend Engineer owns systems and initiatives that span a domain. You set your own technical approach, need minimal technical guidance, and raise the domain's quality bar through design, review, and partnership with peers. As a technologist and a leader, you push the team toward a highly available, scalable, reliable, fault tolerant, and performant microservices platform. You follow and improve Tala's engineering processes and standards while advancing Tala's mission and business objectives. This is a technical leadership role within Tala's technical track, set in a supportive team environment with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development. You will collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the globe. Key Responsibilities Design and Engineering Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data integration layers that power key product features. Author design documents (EDDs) for services in the domain and defend them in review. Design and optimize database schemas and queries for performance and system reliability. Meet project goals without trading away quality, and pay down technical debt as part of delivery rather than as a separate request. Serve as the go-to person for one or more technologies in the domain, following industry developments and explaining concretely how they would or would not apply at Tala. Quality, Review, and Standards Hold the domain's engineering bar in code and design reviews, including for work from other technical teams. Write clean, maintainable code that follows established coding standards. Contribute to the testing infrastructure to increase coverage for backend modules. Verify AI-assisted changes to the same standard as hand-written code. Reliability and Operations Define alerting, SLIs, and SLOs, and advance monitoring of backend modules so availability and response times improve proactively. Handle incidents that the runbook does not cover, fill runbook gaps found during a shift, lead the technical response for domain incidents, and write the RCA. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly across development and production environments. Delivery and Collaboration Own delivery of domain roadmap work and take part in quarterly and sprint planning with a view on feasibility. Anticipate blockers before sprint commitment, and escalate with a problem statement, an impact assessment, and proposed options. Work with Product and business stakeholders to remove ambiguity and to understand what success means for a feature. Work with the team lead to deliver domain solutions, and own service design and implementation end to end, including regressions you introduce. Keep the domain's tickets accurate and its documentation complete enough that it is the first place people look. Work across multiple time zones using asynchronous communication. Mentorship Act as a dedicated mentor to junior and mid-level engineers, with a clear sense of what each is working to improve. Technically lead and mentor a team of Backend Engineers building or extending complex modules. Required Skills and Experience Language: Fluency in English, including clear written communication, which is how most work happens across time zones. Backend engineering: Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating applications in Java, Kotlin, and/or Scala, including a web framework such as Spring. Track record: Has led and delivered multiple domain-significant projects, each validated in production over a meaningful period, including large scale consumer applications on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) using microservices architecture. Technical expertise: Subject-matter expert in their own domain and conversant in adjacent ones. Maintains a working mental model of the wider company architecture and where the seams are. Assesses code and design quality beyond their own area. Solution building and system design: Designs services and their dependencies with security, maintainability, operability, and scale accounted for. Authors design documents (EDDs) and defend them in review. Designs for failure cases, not just the happy path. API design: Expert knowledge of REST API design and development for mobile and web use. Judgment and problem framing: Reframes poorly posed problems instead of answering them as asked. Decides with incomplete information and states the assumptions relied on. Distinguishes reversible from irreversible decisions and applies rigor accordingly. Choose the smallest solution that solves the problem. Data stores: Strong relational database experience (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL) and strong non-relational database experience (Cassandra, Redshift, DynamoDB, or HDFS). Testing and observability: Defines alert thresholds, SLIs, and SLOs for the domain along with the telemetry that supports them. Designs for graceful degradation. Ships new features with monitoring already in place. Co-owns Acceptance Tests coverage decisions with SDET and flags testability gaps before release. Security and compliance: Follows Tala's security and privacy practices in line with ISO-27001 and ISO-27701, follows OWASP secure coding practices, and remediates vulnerabilities within established SLAs. AI fluency: Knows when not to delegate to AI and decomposes domain work into agent-sized units with explicit acceptance criteria. Builds reusable context assets, prompts, and skills that others in the domain adopt. Sets the verification bar for the domain's AI-assisted work. Is accountable for AI-generated code as if it were hand-written, and never puts PII, borrower or credit data, secrets, or production credentials into a prompt or agent context. Delivery and impact: Owns delivery of domain roadmap work and balances feature velocity against technical debt deliberately. Owns an outcome rather than a task list, knows which metrics their systems move, and watches them after release. Ways of working: Expert proficiency in the Agile development process. Prioritizes and communicates well in a fast-paced environment. Strong drive for independent learning and work. Compensation Additional Information

title: Manager Software Test Automation
description: At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. Our Values: We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward. We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team. We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another. The Position: Veracyte is seeking an experienced Manager, Software Test Automation, to lead our Quality Engineering Platform team. This team's mission is to enable every product engineering team to own software quality by providing scalable automation frameworks, self-service testing platforms, AI-assisted quality tools, and engineering best practices that accelerate software delivery while improving reliability, security, and compliance. Rather than functioning as a traditional QA organization, the Quality Engineering Platform team partners with Software Engineering, Product Management, CloudOps, Data & AI, Laboratory Operations, and DevOps to build quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle. The team develops reusable automation platforms, testing infrastructure, quality metrics, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities that allow product teams to continuously validate cloud-native applications, APIs, enterprise integrations, laboratory workflows, and AI-powered solutions. As the Manager, Software Test Automation you will define Veracyte's quality engineering strategy, establish modern engineering practices, and lead a team of Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs), Automation Engineers, and Quality Platform Engineers responsible for enabling engineering excellence across the organization. The ideal candidate is a technical leader passionate about developer productivity, platform engineering, intelligent automation, and building a culture where quality is owned by every engineering team. This is a hybrid role in San Diego, CA Key Responsibilities: Engineering Leadership Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Quality Engineering Platform team. Define and execute the long-term strategy for quality engineering, automation, and developer enablement. Build an engineering culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, ownership, and operational excellence. Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent while fostering career growth and technical leadership. Quality Engineering Platform Build and evolve self-service quality engineering platforms that enable product teams to independently validate their software. Develop scalable automation frameworks supporting unit, integration, API, UI, end-to-end, regression, performance, security, and compliance testing. Create reusable testing libraries, tooling, templates, and CI/CD integrations that standardize quality practices across engineering. Define quality engineering standards, reference architectures, and best practices adopted across development teams. Enable continuous verification through automated quality gates, production validation, synthetic monitoring, and release health checks. AI-Enabled Quality Engineering Define Veracyte's strategy for leveraging AI throughout the software testing lifecycle. Build AI-assisted capabilities for automated test generation, regression analysis, defect classification, release risk assessment, test maintenance, and synthetic test data creation. Partner with Data & AI teams to develop validation strategies for AI-powered products, including LLM evaluation, prompt regression testing, model monitoring, and human-in-the-loop verification. Evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies that improve engineering productivity and software quality. Developer Enablement Partner with Software Engineering teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle using shift-left and shift-right engineering practices. Coach engineering teams on automation strategies, testing best practices, and quality ownership. Provide consulting, tooling, and technical guidance that enables product teams to deliver software with confidence. Partner with DevOps and CloudOps to integrate quality engineering into modern CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery platforms. Operational Excellence Establish engineering metrics that measure software quality, automation effectiveness, developer productivity, release confidence, platform adoption, and customer impact. Drive observability, defect prevention, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure software validation activities support regulatory requirements applicable to healthcare diagnostics, including HIPAA, CAP/CLIA, and FDA software quality expectations where appropriate. Who You Are: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 6 – 7 years of software engineering, quality engineering, or software development experience. 3+ years leading Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, SDET, or Developer Platform engineering teams. Proven experience building engineering platforms that improve software quality and developer productivity. Strong background developing automated testing frameworks for cloud-native applications and distributed systems. Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices. Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering tooling, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong understanding of AWS cloud technologies, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software architecture. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and people leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS), molecular diagnostics, or regulated medical software. Experience validating healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, X12, and related healthcare transactions. Experience testing AI-enabled products, machine learning systems, or generative AI applications. Experience using AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve engineering productivity. Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, REST Assured, Karate, Postman, JUnit, TestNG, or similar automation technologies. Experience building automation using Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native platforms. Experience implementing performance engineering, security testing, chaos engineering, or site reliability engineering practices. Experience working within regulated environments including HIPAA, FDA, CAP/CLIA, ISO 13485, or SOC 2. AWS certifications or software testing certifications are a plus.
